blocks.text: 4 purese in 1 set and 31 colors to choose

items: You can use the 4 bags separately in different way or use them together
Easy to match clothes in different occasions
Varieties and beautiful colors are suitable for young ladies and girls
Gold brand logo and delicate bear doll decoration looks more fashion
Adjustable messenger bag, easy to meet different personal need
The clutch zipper buckle, safe and convenient to use
Presented nicely,are all the features of this fashionable bags set
It has plenty of organized storage and it is a chic way to keep all your essentials
Easily carry your mobile phone, wallet, cosmetic, IPAD, umbrella and other daily things

items.label: MATERIAL
items.value: Made of high quality chain texture synthetic leather with durable gold and smoothly zippers. No animals were harmed and Eco-friendly. Highly anti-scratch and tear-resistant, not easy to be out of shape.

items.label: DESIGNS
items.value: Top zipper closure. Decorated with top handles are very comfortable for carrying. Detailed with high quality gold tone hardware, zippers, flat bottom studs. It can be used as a women tote bag, daily purse, shoulder bag, top handle bag, work bag etc.

items.label: DIMENSION
items.value: Shoulder Handbag: 12.5" x 9.8" x 5.9"(W x H x D) Strap Height:6.2". Messenger Bag: 8.6" x 7" x 3.1"(W x H x D) Wallet Clutch:7" x 4.3"(W x H) Card Holder:4.7" x 3.1"(W x H).

items.label: POCKET
items.value: Shoulder Handbag: One main compartment with one zipper pocket and two slot pockets interior. Three small bag include messenger bag, wallet clutch and card holder, easy to carry with. Can hold your iPad, wallet, makeups, phone and other daily use and keep them organized.

items.label: FUNCTIONAL
items.value: The purse set perfect for dating, shopping, working, traveling, party and other occasions.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: Work, Travel, Shopping, Dating, Anniversary, Party, Birthday
